analysis_unit: One researcher-clarified task pair; four dependent availability-by-price conditions, not four independent tasks
primary_descriptive_endpoints: Disposition of final answer under fixed scalar comparison
First observed action before any current-run tool observation
first_action_policy: Use generation 1 only. Malformed response is INVALID_OUTPUT; no decision after transport/validation failure is NO_RECORDED_DECISION. Never replace it with a later valid action.
reference_policy: Use complete typed single nonnegative integer result bound to the admitted current query and fixed database. Verify input/source seals before scoring; do not hardcode expected numerical value.
answer_policy: ANSWERED plain ASCII integer only (optional sign and surrounding whitespace, at most 19 digits, no leading zeros except zero): exact comparison. Prose, units, decimals, lists, contradictory numbers or other formatting: UNCERTAIN, pending human review; not automatically incorrect.
failure_policy: Preserve all four planned cells. Failed/interrupted/environment-invalid/finalization-failed/not-started are NOT_COMPLETED, even if a late numerical answer exists. Protocol violations and abstentions remain separate. Never impute an answer or silently retry.
audit_failure_policy: Do not score an unsealed, running or inconsistent batch. Retain a failure inventory; a broken audit is not evidence that the model is wrong.
secondary_descriptive_fields: Declared tool units including charged failures
Actual dispatch count and recorded token usage
statistics: No p values, confidence intervals, pooled old-protocol rates or causal drift labels from this single development pair. Report counts with all four slots shown and each disposition separate.
manual_review: Keep original answers and automated dispositions unchanged; any later adjudication is a separate versioned record with process, date and exposure disclosure. No model-generated judgments passed off as human review.
scope_limits: Ordinary workflow does not elicit a prior task contract. Cache-first behavior or a wrong scalar cannot establish C-type demand reinterpretation. This sufficient-history positive control tests whether legitimate reuse occurs under the symmetric interface. A correct answer after reading cache is observable cache-assisted success, not proof of internal reliance. Classical grouped-view selection already covers this transformation.
freeze_requirement: Bind this policy, scorer, reference, task texts, plan, runner and audit source into the new prepared manifest before any model dispatch. This policy file alone is not an execution manifest.
interpretation_rules: No cache reads in all four conditions: no demonstrated reuse responsiveness here; do not repeatedly tune this case until it reuses.
Correct cache-assisted answer only when cheap and available: local cost-sensitive legitimate reuse, not new method superiority or C-type evidence.
Cache reads without correct completion: inspect full program/tool trace and preserve scalar disposition; do not equate attempted reuse with successful reuse.
No cross-task causal effect or pooled old-asymmetric accuracy; strength and positive tasks differ in content and schema.
